tools.name: get_channel_feed
tools.description: Get the latest items from a public interQ channel.

tools.name: search_channel
tools.description: Search the latest items in a public interQ channel.

tools.name: get_channel_urls
tools.description: Get public web, RSS, podcast, JSON, and OPML URLs for an interQ channel.

tools.name: login
tools.description: Start an authenticated interQ session. The password is used only for this TLS request and is not logged or persisted by this server.

tools.name: logout
tools.description: End the current authenticated interQ session.

tools.name: add_item
tools.description: Add an item to the authenticated user stream.

tools.name: remove_item
tools.description: Remove an item from the authenticated user stream. Safe to retry.

tools.name: add_tag
tools.description: Add one tag to an item owned by the authenticated user. Safe to retry.

tools.name: remove_tag
tools.description: Remove one tag from an item owned by the authenticated user. Safe to retry.

tools.name: follow
tools.description: Follow a retailer account. Safe to retry.

tools.name: unfollow
tools.description: Unfollow a retailer account. Safe to retry.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "login" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
